purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0069 in the quantum arena: a maximal A-B wormhole (singlet corner, CHSH 2 root 2) forces the A-C throat to exactly zero and the swept squared throat strengths obey the monogamy bound, so a wormhole cannot be shared three ways, while a GHZ state shares classical-strength links in both.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
